speaker.name: Requirements Reuben
speaker.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

output.objection: You are treating my acceptance of automated validation as a concession of quality, but I am only trading manual effort for rigorous automated checks. I need the record to reflect that we are still demanding the same level of data integrity, just with a different execution method.
output.correction: I did not say we can skip testing the data validation logic itself. I said I will not require a human to manually verify every single record if the automated pipeline proves its reliability through rigorous unit tests.
